story.summary: Aaliyah's "Back Forth" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Back & Forth" is the debut single performed by American singer Aaliyah for her debut studio album, Age Ain't Nothing but a Number (1994).
story.fullStory:
Aaliyah's "Back Forth" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Back & Forth" is the debut single performed by American singer Aaliyah for her debut studio album, Age Ain't Nothing but a Number (1994).

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

Back Forth was released in 1994.

Album: Age Ain't Nothing But A Number (1994).

"Back & Forth" is the debut single performed by American singer Aaliyah for her debut studio album, Age Ain't Nothing but a Number (1994).
The song was written and produced by R&B singer R.
Kelly, and lyrically the song is about a teenager's excitement for partying on the weekend with friends.
Age Ain't Nothing but a Number is the debut studio album by American singer Aaliyah.
It was released on May 24, 1994, by Blackground Records and Jive Records.
After being signed by her uncle Barry Hankerson, Aaliyah was introduced to recording artist and producer R.
